disclosure:
Actual Chromium phone-landscape emulation; no physical device/Safari claim.

One disclosed route-stop debug warp precedes native touch dismount. Thereafter,
all movement, doors, menus and return-to-bike use CDP touch or native tap. No
scene teleport or save/item/health grant occurs. This is functional/visual
capture, not exclusive frame-time measurement.
